definitions.full: H6959. qoba קוֺבַע noun [masculine] helmet (word of peculiar form, and dubious √; probably foreign word; compare Ethiopic turban, tiara, cowl , so Syriac ; קוֺבְעָא ᵑ7 turban ); — absolute ׳ק Ezek 23:24 ; construct נְחשֶׁת ק֫וֺבַע 1Sam 17:38 . — compare also כּוֺבַע .
